prayerExcerpt.en-US: In every circumstance of life may we see and follow you.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Possamos reconhecer e seguir a vossa vontade em todas as circunstâncias da vida.

meta.face: A woman of about forty-five with an olive Roman complexion and a broad-cheeked, rounded-square face with a firm, rounded jaw — a straight Roman nose continuing the line of the brow, large, dark, heavy-lashed eyes under fine dark eyebrows, full cheekbones and a full, serene, faintly smiling mouth; the eyes lifted a little toward the angel.
meta.basis: Italian images give her a black tunic and a long white veil, usually without wimple or scapular, and include the archangel only she could see, shown small; her biographers describe him as a boy of about nine with golden hair in a dalmatic. The face is an artistic choice for a Roman matron of middle age.
